scope: 用户明确指定的PNG参考文件，原字节复制；本清单不是原DDS/TGA提取过程或原游戏shader的验证记录。

analysis.rgb_luminance: Pillow RGB.convert(L): rounded Rec.601 RGB weighting in stored 8-bit RGB, not shader-linear-space luminance
analysis.statistics_domain: stored PNG 8-bit channels; alpha shown independently as grayscale
analysis.visual_inspection: Agent inspected each reference RGB, alpha and RGB luminance contact-sheet row via view_image on 2026-10-11.

dimension_policy: 保留所有PNG原宽高；不烘焙、不改色、不缩放、不旋转。64x64只作为微纹理，256x64保留4:1比例，调节shader UV与采样强度。

godot_derivative_import_configuration.status: all .import configs checked; root task performs unified Godot reimport and GPU acceptance
godot_derivative_import_configuration.note: 源PNG原字节不变；Godot导入衍生纹理包含mips，并保留默认fix_alpha_border。ctex不宣称与源PNG逐位一致。

limitations: 未运行Godot，本记录不证明游戏内视觉验收。
用途基于实测通道和预览形态，未验证原游戏shader使用合同。
PNG预览与源DDS/TGA之间的转换保真未在本任务验证。
未提供或验证公开许可、原创性及外部再分发权利。

pixel_relationships.interpretation: 仅记录像素关系，未据此推断附件作者、编辑历史或许可。

current_implementation_selection.status: first-pass binding and 10 actual Godot GPU samples checked; original-game 3D splash structure remains a follow-up after report study
current_implementation_selection.user_caustics_selection: duel_waterdetail bound for shallow-water caustics; user attachment retained as rotated-alpha-equivalent different-RGB alternative; do not overlay both
current_implementation_selection.ship_masks: wake alpha_floor=.018, source mask multiplied by froth detail; geometric taper and multi-row head/tail fade; sparse water spash alpha and ellipse for spray, dense splash02 internal detail only

visual_validation.scope: fixed accepted ticks; no wall-time performance or complete original-game recreation claim
